annotations.title: Predict citation likelihood for a URL

description: Score citation likelihood for a URL from public signals (Wikipedia link presence, schema.org markup, /llms.txt, GitHub and Reddit references, canonical hygiene, HTTPS). No LLM fired - all heuristic. Returns 0-100 score, grade, signal breakdown, and ranked fixes.

url.description: URL to score for citation likelihood. Must be absolute http(s).

name: citations_predict

fixes.description: Ranked list of concrete improvements to raise the score.

grade.description: Letter grade (A-F) derived from the score.

signals.description: Per-signal boolean/numeric values used to compute the score.
